Seminar

Open Source Odyssey

The Source Lab and FSMK presented an introduction to the open-source world for students at HKBK. The seminar brought together three starting points for exploring free software.

Session details

Date
Thursday, 12 November 2026
Venue
Seminar Hall, HKBK College of Engineering
Presented by
The Source Lab × FSMK

What the session covered

FOSS fundamentals

What makes software free and open source, and why the freedom to study and share it matters.

Linux unlocked

An introduction to Linux as an entry point into the wider world of free software.

The open-source ecosystem

How software projects and the communities around them fit together.

Student free software community at HKBK College of Engineering.
